title: Reading Drill — Choosing a floor surface for a playgroup — Building a comparison
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Choosing a floor surface for a playgroup — Building a comparison
passages.body:
**A** The playgroup staff had been asked to investigate moveable toys scratching some parts of a floor in Bramley. Its first task was to decide which signs of improvement could be compared between sites. It settled on the area with permanent marks, because the same measure could be applied in the original setting and at a second location.

**B** During a nine-week comparison, the team used dated photographs at both places. It recorded outcomes separately for each site. Because variation in toy weight might influence the figures, the team used a column in the record to show when that condition was present. The surveys included quiet periods as well as busy ones.

**C** The team then put forward additional mats under storage. Its report asked for another comparison after the change had been tried. This would distinguish a genuine effect from an improvement that could have occurred anyway. The report did not assume that the more successful site before the change would be the better site afterwards.
